market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil above $101, trade war escalation, and bond yield volatility. Expect continued risk-off in equities with rotation into energy, defense, and gold. Bessent's rate intervention failure adds uncertainty. Asian stocks pressured by inflation fears. 2-3 week window of elevated volatility likely.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle remains structurally intact despite bubble concerns. Energy transition and commodity tightness (copper, oil) support multi-year upside in resource equities. Trade fragmentation (US-Canada, US-China) creates permanent supply chain restructuring. Dividend and value strategies outperform in higher-rate regime. 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive for selective sectors.
